posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-lan-proxy 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。局域网访问 dsh web UI：在 0.0.0.0 监听并把 HTTP/HTTPS 与 WebSocket/wss 转发到回环 web 服务器，带 DNS 重绑定防护与回环-only 上游白名单。

posts.en:
dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-lan-proxy is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. LAN access to the dsh web UI: forwards HTTP/HTTPS and WebSocket/wss from 0.0.0.0 to the loopback web server, with DNS-rebinding protection and a loopback-only upstream whitelist.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-86b2e00aa1f6d5c49ff6.html
